This test verifies the remove of unused parameters in case of syntax errors.
Issue golang/go#70268.

-- go.mod --
module unused.mod

go 1.21

-- a/a.go --
package a

func A(x, unused int) int { //@codeaction("unused", "refactor.rewrite.removeUnusedParam", result=a)
	return x
}

-- @a/a/a.go --
package a

func A(x int) int { //@codeaction("unused", "refactor.rewrite.removeUnusedParam", result=a)
	return x
}

-- b/b.go --
package b

import "unused.mod/a"

func main() {
	var x Undeclared //@diag("Undeclared", re"undeclared|undefined")
	_ = &x.S.F
	_ = &x.A[0]
	_ = &(1 + 2) //@diag("(1 + 2)", re"cannot take address")
	a.A(1, 2)
	a.A/*dsdd*/(/*cccc*/ 1,


	) //@diag(")", re"not enough arguments")
}

-- @a/b/b.go --
package b

import "unused.mod/a"

func main() {
	var x Undeclared //@diag("Undeclared", re"undeclared|undefined")
	_ = &x.S.F
	_ = &x.A[0]
	_ = &(1 + 2) //@diag("(1 + 2)", re"cannot take address")
	a.A(1)
	a.A /*dsdd*/ ( /*cccc*/ 1) //@diag(")", re"not enough arguments")
}
